scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['.next','coverage','playwright-report','test-results']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.check: npm run validate:content && npm run validate:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.build:preview: ALLOW_PREVIEW_ENV=true CONTACT_FORM_DEMO_MODE=true ALLOW_MISSING_BRAND_ASSETS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://preview.invalid npm run build
scripts.build:ci: ALLOW_MISSING_BRAND_ASSETS=true npm run verify:assets && npm run validate:content && npm run validate:frontend && next build
scripts.build: npm run verify:environment && npm run verify:assets && npm run validate:content && npm run validate:frontend && next build
